title: CAP THEOREM AND PACELC
subtitle: When the network splits, choose between refusing requests and answering with possibly stale data, separately for each feature.
footer: System Design, Step by Step · core concepts

items: The network between two replicas breaks. Partitions will happen, so P is not optional.
A user asks the node that can't see the latest write.
Either refuse (consistent, unavailable) or answer with stale data (available, inconsistent).

head: Feature
Choice
rows: AP: stale for seconds is fine

blocks.text: "CAP is a per-feature choice: the booking path is CP, browsing is AP."

items: Partitions will happen, so the real choice is C or A during one.
Choose per feature, not per system.
PACELC: even without partitions, stronger consistency costs latency.

blocks.text: "Booking is CP: I'd rather reject than double-sell. Browsing is AP: a few seconds stale is fine."
